description: Execute bounded TypeScript with top-level await against progressively discovered Kubernetes capabilities. Use tools.list(), tools.search(), tools.help(), and typed namespaces; inspect tools.disabled() for policy denials. Target other clusters with the `context` argument, tools.withContext(name), or a per-call `context`; tools.kubernetes.contexts() lists them. Return a value from the script. Full documentation and types are available through the code-mode prompt and file:///sys/global.d.ts.

code.description: TypeScript code to execute via the sandboxed runtime. Top-level await is supported.

context.description: Default Kubernetes context name or alias for every tool call in the script. Per-call `context` arguments and tools.withContext() take precedence.

input.description: Optional input payload available to the script.

name: run_code
title: Run Kubernetes Analysis Code
